qu_550343.title: Factory Tour in 60 Seconds: Molding → Printing → Packing
qu_550343.transcript: Walk our Guangdong factory in one minute: injection molding lines forming stadium cups, UV and screen printing stations, LED module assembly, and the packing floor where every custom order is counted, boxed and palletized for US freight. BOOM Drinkware runs plastic, silicone and LED drinkware lines under one roof — low MOQ, artwork review, 7–12 day standard turnaround.

qu_550343.title: UV Printing on Stadium Cups: Artwork → Cure → QC
qu_550343.transcript: See how full-color UV printing works on 16oz stadium cups: digital artwork setup, 360° rotary printing, instant LED-UV curing, and our adhesion cross-hatch test. UV printing delivers photo-quality gradients on plastic cups with no plate fees — ideal for logos with many colors at low minimums.

qu_550343.title: LED Cup Light Modes Demo: Steady, Flash & Liquid-Activated
qu_550343.transcript: Every LED light-up cup mode in 50 seconds: steady glow for table service, flash mode for dance floors, strobe for peak moments, and liquid-activated cups that light on pour. All modes use replaceable button cells, FDA food-contact PS shells, and support custom logo printing on the cup body.

qu_550343.title: Tailgate Party Kit Walkthrough: What Is in the Kit
qu_550343.zh: 车尾派对套件开箱讲解
qu_550343.transcript: Unbox our Tailgate Party Kit: fifty 16oz stadium cups, fifty can coolers, fifty credit-card bottle openers and a 4L ice bucket — all printed with your logo in one production run. Mix and match any component; the minimum order quantity is 10 pieces. One quote, one shipment, game-day ready.

qu_550343.title: Cup Materials Explained: PP vs PET vs Tritan vs Silicone
qu_550343.zh: 材质科普：PP vs PET vs Tritan vs 硅胶
qu_550343.transcript: An honest factory comparison of the four materials we mold: PP — the flexible, affordable workhorse for stadium cups; PET — crystal-clear and rigid for cold-drink disposables; Tritan — premium copolyester, glass-clear, drop-proof and dishwasher-durable at 2.6–3.2× the PP resin cost; food-grade silicone — unbreakable, pool-safe and collapsible. All four are BPA-free and FDA food-contact compliant.

qu_550343.title: sample requests Kit Unboxing: What You Get & How to Approve
qu_550343.zh: 样品与图稿审核包开箱
qu_550343.transcript: What arrives in your free BOOM Drinkware sample kit: the cup styles you picked, material swatches, print-quality references for UV, screen and laser, and a prepaid approval card. Samples are usually completed 3–5 days after drawing approval. Approve the sample before confirming the production schedule.

qu_550343.title: Color Changing Cups Demo: Cold-Activated Magic
qu_550343.transcript: Watch a stadium cup shift color the moment ice-cold drink hits the wall. Our cold-activated pigment is embedded in the PP shell — it survives hundreds of wash cycles and works with your custom print on top. The party trick guests film and post.

qu_550343.title: QC Before Shipment: Our 6-Point Inspection
qu_550343.transcript: Our six-point pre-shipment inspection: material certificate check, print registration, adhesion testing, leak and drop tests on silicone and LED lines, quantity count against PO, and carton drop-test before palletizing. Every order ships with a QC photo report.

qu_550343.title: FAQ Shorts: MOQ, Rush Time & Split Shipping
qu_550343.transcript: Three fast answers: Our minimum order quantity is 10 pieces. Standard turnaround is 7–12 business days with paid rush down to 3–5 days. And yes — we split shipments to multiple venues or hotel addresses at cost.

qu_550343.title: Nightclub LED Party Pack: Full Setup in 90 Seconds
qu_550343.transcript: A complete nightclub table-service setup from one pack: LED cups flashing on pour, LED ice buckets holding the champagne line, LED foam sticks for the crowd and LED ice cubes in every glass. One supplier, one freight bill, one unforgettable night — all with your venue branding.

qu_550343.title: How We Pack & Ship Your Bulk Order
qu_550343.transcript: From packing line to your dock: inner polybags, five-ply export cartons, palletizing with corner guards, and container loading for LA/Long Beach or Houston. Air freight options for rush events. Every carton is photographed before sealing — you get the full packing report.

qu_550343.title: Wedding Welcome Set Assembly: Cups, Stoppers & Coasters
qu_550343.zh: 婚礼迎宾套装组装演示
qu_550343.transcript: How a wedding welcome set comes together: frosted cups with the couple's monogram, silicone wine stoppers as take-home favors, matching coasters, all packed per welcome bag. One planner ordered 300 sets for a destination wedding — delivered to the hotel on schedule.

yu_759220.title: Tooling & Molding
yu_759220.copy: Food-grade PP, PET, Tritan™ and silicone resin becomes your cup on our injection and thermoforming lines — dozens of existing molds, custom tooling on request.

yu_759220.title: Decoration — UV, Heat Transfer, Laser & Color-Changing Ink
yu_759220.copy: Four in-house decoration processes cover every logo: photographic full-color UV, wrap-around heat transfer, precise laser marking and cold-activated color-changing ink.

yu_759220.title: QC & artwork review
yu_759220.copy: Every order starts with an artwork review and ends with piece-level QC — print registration, color match and leak checks before anything ships.

yu_759220.title: Packing & Fast US Freight
yu_759220.copy: Retail-ready or bulk-packed, cartons leave our dock on a project-specific production schedule standard schedules — with rush lanes down to a schedule confirmed for the project when your event date is fixed.

_6_775598.q: What is the minimum order for custom drinkware?
_6_775598.a: Minimum order: 10 pieces on most product lines — including stadium cups, frosted cups and tumblers. The minimum order quantity is 10 pieces. See how our low MOQ program works.

_6_775598.q: Can I Request a sample before ordering?
_6_775598.a: Yes. We ship a sample requests kit with cup materials, print quality examples and color swatches so you can approve everything in hand before production. Claim your sample requests here.

_6_775598.q: How fast is production and shipping to the US?
_6_775598.a: Standard production runs a project-specific production schedule plus freight. When your event date is fixed, rush production compresses manufacturing to a schedule confirmed for the project with priority packing and express US freight options.

_6_775598.q: Which printing process should I choose for my logo?
_6_775598.a: For 1–3 spot colors at volume, screen printing is the value pick. For full-color art, gradients or photographic logos, choose UV printing. Compare screen printing and UV printing side by side.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom plastic cups?
faqs.a: Our with a minimum order of 10 pieces for most custom plastic cup styles, and you can mix sizes and colors within a single order. It is one of the lowest factory MOQs in the industry — see how the program works on our low MOQ page.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to print a logo on plastic cups?
faqs.a: Unit pricing starts around $0.35 per cup at volume and depends on size, material and print colors. Every quote includes an artwork review, and you can approve a physical sample before production begins.

faqs.q: Are your plastic cups food-safe and BPA-free?
faqs.a: Yes. All BOOM Drinkware plastic cups are molded from FDA food-contact PP, PET or Tritan™ resin and are 100% BPA-free. SGS test reports and food-contact certificates are available with every order on request.

faqs.q: Can I get full-color printing on plastic cups?
faqs.a: Absolutely. UV printing applies full-wrap CMYK artwork with gradients and photo detail directly onto the cup. For simple logos, 1–3 color screen printing is the most economical option at volume.

faqs.q: How long does production take?
faqs.a: Standard production runs a project-specific production schedule plus freight to your US address. Working against a fixed event date? Rush production compresses manufacturing to a schedule confirmed for the project with priority packing and express shipping options.

faqs.q: Are silicone cups really unbreakable?
faqs.a: Yes. Food-grade silicone flexes on impact and simply cannot shatter, which makes these cups the default choice anywhere breakable drinkware is banned — pools, beaches, boats, festivals and dance floors.

faqs.q: Are silicone cups dishwasher and heat safe?
faqs.a: Completely. Our food-grade silicone is rated from −40°F to 480°F, so the cups go straight into the dishwasher, handle hot drinks, and never stain or hold odors. LFGB and FDA food-contact reports ship on request.

faqs.q: Can I print my logo on silicone cups?
faqs.a: Yes — screen printing lays down bold spot colors, while laser etching creates a permanent tone-on-tone mark that never wears off in the dishwasher. Details and artwork specs are on our laser engraving page.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for custom silicone cups?
faqs.a: The minimum order is 10 pieces with an artwork review. Marbled, glow-in-the-dark and two-tone variants carry the same low MOQ as standard colors.

faqs.q: Which venues buy silicone cups most?
faqs.a: Pools, beaches, resorts and festivals are the biggest buyers — anywhere breakable drinkware is a liability. Many venues brand them for bar service, then retail the same cup as a souvenir.

faqs.q: How long do the LEDs in light up cups last?
faqs.a: Each set of AG13 batteries powers 8–12 hours of continuous glow — comfortably a full event night. Batteries are replaceable at the twist-lock base, so the cups stay in service event after event.

faqs.q: Where can I buy wholesale LED light up cups?
faqs.a: Factory-direct from BOOM Drinkware with a 10-piece minimum — no distributor markup. Wholesale buyers get tiered volume pricing, an artwork review, and rush restock options for venue programs.

faqs.q: Are LED cups safe for drinks?
faqs.a: Yes. The LED unit sits in a fully sealed base compartment that never touches the beverage, and the cup body is FDA food-contact PS plastic. Hand-wash the cup and keep the base dry — that is the whole care routine.

faqs.q: Can I print my logo on LED cups?
faqs.a: Yes. A 1-color screen print on the cup body is the value pick; full-color UV printing wraps detailed art around the cup. The LED base itself can also be branded for sponsors who want the glow to carry their name.

faqs.q: Do LED cups have different light modes?
faqs.a: Every BOOM Drinkware LED cup ships with three modes — steady, flash and strobe — switched by a button in the base. Sound-activated variants pulse with the music, which is why nightclubs and festivals specify them.

faqs.q: Which bar accessories can I customize?
faqs.a: Bottle openers, wine stoppers, pourers, coasters, drink markers, silicone straws, can and bottle sleeves, bar mats, stirrers, serving trays and acrylic ice buckets — everything is molded in-house in plastic or silicone, so nothing breaks in a busy bar.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for bar accessories?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 10 pieces. Share your model, size, colour and quantity requirements for a project quotation.

faqs.q: Can you match our bar or venue brand colors?
faqs.a: Yes — send a Pantone number and we color-match the plastic or silicone before printing your logo. an artwork review is confirmed before production.

faqs.q: Do bar accessories ship with our cups in one order?
faqs.a: Yes — accessories kitting with cups, buckets and gift sets is a specialty: one quote, one shipment, per-venue packing on request.

faqs.q: Do these artwork previews show the final print result?
faqs.a: No — they are style previews. Once you send your logo, our team prepares a true-to-scale digital proof on the exact SKU, including print area, color and position, for your approval before production.

faqs.q: How do I get my logo on these products?
faqs.a: Send your artwork (Illustrator/PDF/PNG) with the SKU codes you like. You get an artwork review within 24–48 hours and tiered pricing from 10 pieces on stock styles.

faqs.q: Which printing methods do you support?
faqs.a: UV printing, screen printing and heat transfer on plastic and silicone, plus in-mold deboss for molded styles — we recommend the best method per SKU and artwork.

faqs.q: Can you preview my own logo instead of the house mark?
faqs.a: Yes — that is exactly the workflow. The gallery shows the house mark as a demo; your own logo is applied the same way in your artwork review.

steps.title: Define the product
steps.copy: Start with a cup, ice bucket or bar accessory. Agree the intended use, dimensions, logo, quantity, destination and required arrival date. New shapes need a separate tooling review.

steps.title: Form the shell
steps.copy: Review the specified resin, tool and shell geometry. Prepare the cup or housing and check the light-transmitting area, module fit and part interfaces for the selected design.

steps.title: Configure the LED module
steps.copy: Select a compatible light module and define colours, modes and activation. Review battery or charging arrangements and access to the power compartment. Any circuit changes require a separate technical review.

steps.title: Apply the branding
steps.copy: Choose an appropriate logo process for the substrate and artwork. Review location, coverage and contrast with the light both on and off; keep controls and light paths clear.

steps.title: Assemble the product
steps.copy: Fit the light module, power components and housing in the agreed sequence. Check the mounting, closures and any lids or accessories against the approved sample.

steps.title: Inspect against the sample
steps.copy: Check the specified lighting modes, activation, appearance, decoration and fit. Agree runtime, ingress or destination-specific testing separately where the project requires it.

steps.title: Pack for the order
steps.copy: Confirm individual packaging, protective separators, cartons, care information and battery details. Review applicable transport documents for the actual battery and destination before dispatch.

faqs.q: What can I customize on LED drinkware?
faqs.a: Start with the product model, logo, body colour and packaging. Lighting colours, modes, activation and power options depend on the selected module and housing. New tooling or electronics changes are reviewed separately.

faqs.q: Do all LED cups have the same light effects or batteries?
faqs.a: No. Review the actual model and sample. Button, pressure or liquid activation, colour-changing effects, battery access and charging arrangements are model-specific.

faqs.q: Can I add a logo to light-up cups, ice buckets and coasters?
faqs.a: Share the model and vector artwork. Confirm substrate compatibility, print area and readability with the light switched on and off before approving the decoration sample.

faqs.q: What are the MOQ and production lead time?
faqs.a: They depend on the model, artwork, lighting configuration, packaging and development scope. Send estimated quantities and the required arrival date for a project quotation. Stock purchase minimums are not custom-logo minimums.

faqs.q: Are LED drinkware products waterproof or dishwasher safe?
faqs.a: Do not assume either property. Follow the care instructions for the selected model, keep electrical components away from moisture as instructed, and request relevant test information for any special requirement.

faqs.q: Is glow-in-the-dark or UV-reactive drinkware the same as LED drinkware?
faqs.a: No. LED products use an electrical light source. UV-reactive and glow-in-the-dark materials work differently; they are not included in this LED model selection unless the product also has an LED module.

faqs.q: What should I send for an LED product quotation?
faqs.a: Send model numbers or reference images, estimated quantities, intended use, logo artwork, desired lighting, power preference, packaging and destination. Identify any required tests or documents so the quotation can define their scope.

faqs.q: PET 膜热转印与 UV 印刷有什么不同？
faqs.a: 热转印先将图案印在 PET 载体膜上，再通过热量和压力转移到杯身。UV 印刷则直接在物体表面喷印油墨并固化。应根据实际材料与杯型选择适用方式。

faqs.q: 如何确认印刷耐久性？

faqs.q: LED 杯可以使用热转印吗？
faqs.a: 需由生产端核对杯壳、转印系统及组装顺序。应避免电池和电子组件受热，并保留所需透光区域。

mainEntity.name: Which artwork works well for screen printing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solid spot-colour logos, lettering and clear shapes are a useful starting point. Fine detail, minimum line width and registration must be reviewed at the actual print size.

mainEntity.name: Can screen printing reproduce photographs or gradients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photographic and continuous-tone artwork requires a separate process review. Compare UV printing or heat transfer when the brief needs detailed multicolour imagery.

mainEntity.name: How many colours can I use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each colour normally requires its own screen and registration. The practical colour count depends on the selected cup, artwork, ink and production setup; confirm it in the quotation.

mainEntity.name: How is print durability confirmed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agree the substrate, ink system, curing conditions, care instructions and any required tests. Approve an actual sample rather than assuming a wash-cycle rating.

mainEntity.name: What should I send for a quotation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send the model or reference image, vector artwork, colour reference, print location, quantity, packaging, destination and required arrival date. Request screen and setup charges as separate quote items.

zh.name: 丝网印刷杯具定制 | BOOM Drinkware
zh.description: 了解杯具丝网印刷的图稿分色、网版定位、刮印与固化检查四步流程，按型号确认专色 Logo 与样品。

mainEntity.name: 什么图稿适合丝网印刷？

acceptedAnswer.text: 实色专色 Logo、文字与清晰图形适合作为起点；细节、最小线宽与套色精度需按实际印刷尺寸核对。

mainEntity.name: 丝印可以还原照片或渐变吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 照片与连续渐变需单独评估工艺；如需精细多彩图像，可同时比较 UV 印刷与热转印。

mainEntity.name: 可以印多少个颜色？

acceptedAnswer.text: 通常每个颜色需要独立网版与套位。可用颜色数取决于杯型、图稿、油墨与产线配置，在报价时确认。

mainEntity.name: 如何确认图案耐用性？

acceptedAnswer.text: 先约定基材、油墨体系、固化条件、清洁说明与所需测试，通过实物样品确认，不预设耐洗次数。

mainEntity.name: 询价需要提供什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: 请提供型号或参考图、矢量图稿、颜色参考、印刷位置、数量、包装、目的地与到货要求，并在报价中列明网版及制版费用。

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom cups?
items.a: Our standard minimum order quantity is 50 pieces for most custom plastic cups, and 100 pieces for silicone and LED drinkware. That is one of the lowest true factory MOQs in the industry — no reseller markup, no forced case quantities. Larger runs unlock better per-unit pricing, but you can start small.

items.q: Can I order custom cups with my logo in small quantities?
items.a: Yes. BOOM Drinkware specializes in small-quantity custom orders: 50 pieces is enough for most cup styles with your logo printed. You still get an artwork review before production and the same factory-direct pricing structure as bigger buyers — just scaled to your quantity.

items.q: Where to buy custom cups with logo no minimum?
items.a: Truly "no minimum" offers usually come from print-on-demand resellers at very high per-cup prices. As a factory, our honest floor is 50 pieces — low enough for birthday parties, small teams and test runs, with real wholesale pricing. For most buyers, a 50-piece factory order beats a 12-piece reseller order on total cost.

items.q: Can I mix colors and sizes in one order?
items.a: Yes — you can mix cup colors within one order at no extra charge as long as the print design stays the same. Mixing sizes (for example 16oz and 22oz stadium cups) is also possible; each size carries its own 10-piece minimum. Tell your rep the split and we will quote it as one combined order with one setup.

items.q: How much does it cost to print a logo on cups?
items.a: For a one-color screen printed logo, expect roughly $0.40–$0.90 per cup all-in at 500 pieces, including the cup itself. Full-color UV printing runs higher per unit but has no color-count limits. Quantity is the biggest lever — doubling your order typically drops the per-cup cost 20–35%.

items.q: How much do custom tumblers cost in bulk?
items.a: Bulk custom plastic tumblers start around $1.25 per unit at 500 pieces for a 16oz double-wall style with a one-color print. Large 40oz handled tumblers with full-wrap prints run $2.50–$4.50 depending on quantity and process. Every quote includes an artwork review so you see exact pricing before committing.

items.q: How much do custom shot glasses cost in bulk?
items.a: Custom plastic shot glasses start near $0.35 per unit at 1,000 pieces with a one-color print; LED light-up shot glasses run $0.90–$1.60 depending on quantity and light modes. Bar and nightclub buyers typically order 500–5,000 pieces per run to hit the best price breaks.

items.q: How does quantity affect the price per custom cup?
items.a: Price per cup drops steeply with quantity because setup, mold prep and print calibration are fixed costs spread across the run. Moving from 100 to 500 pieces typically saves 25–35% per unit; 5,000+ pieces unlocks our deepest wholesale tiers. We quote every price break transparently so you can pick your sweet spot.

items.q: Are there setup fees for custom printed cups?
items.a: We charge a small one-time plate/screen setup per design — typically $25–$45 depending on the process — and it is waived on reorders of the same artwork. UV digital printing has no setup fee at all. Your quote always lists setup separately, so there are never hidden charges.

items.q: Are mold costs included for custom shaped cups?
items.a: Standard cup shapes use our existing molds, so there is zero mold cost. A fully custom shape (OEM project) requires new injection molds, quoted separately based on size and complexity — typically a one-time tooling investment you own. We amortize tooling across production runs whenever possible.

items.q: What is the cheapest way to print cups with a logo?
items.a: One-color screen printing on a standard plastic stadium cup is the cheapest way to put a logo on cups — as low as $0.40 per cup all-in at modest quantities. Keep the design to one ink color, choose a stock cup color, and order 500+ pieces to hit the lowest per-unit cost.

items.q: Which printing process should I choose for my logo?
items.a: One to three spot colors at high volume: screen printing is your best value. Full-color logos, gradients or small runs: UV printing wins — no color limits, no screens. Premium matte finishes: laser engraving. Your rep will recommend a process from your artwork, free, before you commit.

items.q: Can you print full-color photos on cups?
items.a: Yes. Heat transfer printing wraps full-color photographic artwork around the entire cup with no per-color charges, and UV printing reproduces photo-quality images on flat print zones. Send us your highest-resolution file — we will tell you honestly which process renders it best on your chosen cup.

items.q: What can I customize on LED drinkware?
items.a: Start with the product model, logo, body colour and packaging. Lighting colours, modes, activation and power options depend on the selected module and housing. New tooling or electronics changes are reviewed separately.

items.q: Does laser engraving work on plastic?
items.a: Yes — on the right plastics. Laser engraving etches crisp, permanent marks into powder-coated and matte-finish plastic and silicone drinkware, revealing a contrasting layer beneath. It does not work well on bare clear plastic; for those, we recommend UV or screen printing instead.

items.q: Are your cups BPA-free and food safe?
items.a: Yes. Every BOOM Drinkware cup is molded from BPA-free, food-contact-grade resin — PP, PET, Tritan™ or food-grade silicone — and our inks and coatings meet FDA food-contact requirements. LFGB compliance documentation is available for silicone lines, and SGS test reports ship on request with any order.

items.q: Are your products dishwasher safe?
items.a: Most of our plastic and silicone cups are top-rack dishwasher safe, and silicone lines handle full dishwasher cycles. We recommend hand washing for UV-printed and LED drinkware to protect the print and electronics — care instructions are printed on every spec sheet and order confirmation.

items.q: Do you sell glass or stainless steel cups?
items.a: No — BOOM Drinkware specializes exclusively in plastic, silicone and LED drinkware. Staying inside three material families keeps our molds, inks and QC tightly focused, which is why our shatterproof alternatives look and feel premium. For glass-ban venues and pools, our silicone and Tritan™ lines are the go-to substitutes.

items.q: Can I Request a sample before ordering?
items.a: Yes — we ship sample requests of stock cup styles so you can feel the material, weight and print quality before committing. Printed samples with your own logo carry a small run charge that is credited back on your production order. Sample kits typically arrive within 5–7 business days in the US.

items.q: How long does production take?
items.a: Standard production runs a project-specific production schedule after you approve the artwork review, plus transit time to your US address. Rush production compresses manufacturing to as few as 5 business days for qualifying styles and quantities. Your quote always states an exact ship date, not a vague window.

items.q: Do you ship to all 50 US states?
items.a: Yes — we deliver to all 50 states, with most orders moving by ocean freight to West or Gulf Coast ports then ground to your door. Air freight is available for deadline-critical orders. Shipping is quoted door-to-door with duties handled, so the price you approve is the price you pay.

items.q: Can you handle event deadlines?
items.a: Yes — event deadlines are our specialty. Tell us your event date when you request a quote and we back-plan production, proofing and freight to land with buffer. For tight turnarounds we combine rush production with air freight; we will tell you honestly if a date is not achievable.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept, and how much deposit is required?
items.a: Our standard production terms are T/T (bank wire): 30% deposit to start production, 70% balance before shipment — every term is written into your pro forma invoice before you pay anything. For sample orders and small trial runs we also accept PayPal and major credit cards. We do not ask for 100% upfront on first orders.

zh.q: 你们接受哪些付款方式？需要多少定金？
zh.a: 大货标准条款为 T/T 电汇：30% 定金启动生产，70% 尾款在发货前付清——所有条款在付款前都会写入形式发票。样品单和小额试单还支持 PayPal 与主流信用卡。首单我们不要求 100% 预付。

items.q: Do you offer net payment terms for larger accounts?
items.a: Yes — qualified repeat buyers can move to Net-15 and then Net-30 terms after three prepaid orders and a standard credit check. Terms are granted per account, not per order, and are confirmed in writing. New accounts always start prepaid so both sides build a track record first.

zh.q: 大客户可以赊账（Net 账期）吗？
zh.a: 可以——符合条件的回头客户在完成三次预付订单并通过标准信用审核后，可开放 Net-15，进而 Net-30 账期。账期按账户授予而非按订单，并以书面形式确认。新账户一律从预付开始，先建立合作记录。

items.q: Which Incoterms do you support, and who pays US import duties?
items.a: We quote EXW, FOB or DDP — your choice. On DDP (delivered duty paid) we arrange freight and customs clearance and the US import duties are included in your quoted price, so the number you approve is the landed cost. On EXW or FOB, your own broker handles import and duties are billed to you directly by US Customs. Your quote states the Incoterm explicitly so there are no surprises.

zh.q: 你们支持哪些贸易条款？美国进口关税由谁承担？
zh.a: 我们支持 EXW、FOB 或 DDP 报价——由您选择。DDP（完税后交货）条款下，我们负责全程运输与清关，美国进口关税已包含在报价中，您确认的价格即落地成本。EXW 或 FOB 条款下，由您的报关行办理进口，关税由美国海关直接向您收取。每份报价都会明确标注所采用的贸易条款，绝无隐藏费用。

items.q: How do orders ship — ocean, air or courier — and is door-to-door available?
items.a: Most wholesale orders move by ocean freight to US West or Gulf Coast ports, then ground carrier to your door — the most economical option for 1,000+ piece runs. Air freight is available for deadline-critical orders, and international express (DHL/FedEx/UPS) covers samples and small urgent runs. Door-to-door delivery is available on all three; your quote lists transit time per option so you can trade cost against speed.

zh.q: 订单如何运输——海运、空运还是快递？可以门到门吗？
zh.a: 大宗订单通常海运至美国西岸或墨西哥湾港口，再转陆运派送到门——1,000 只以上订单的最经济方案。交期紧急的订单可选空运；样品与小额急单走国际快递（DHL/FedEx/UPS）。三种方式均支持门到门，报价会列出各方案的运输时效，便于您在成本与速度之间权衡。

items.q: Do printed samples cost money, and is the sample fee refundable?
items.a: Stock (blank) samples are free on most styles — no charge at all. Printed samples with your own logo carry a small run charge to cover screen setup and machine time, and that charge is credited back in full on your production order for the same design. Sampling is how we earn your first bulk order, not a profit center.

zh.q: 印 Logo 的样品收费吗？样品费能退吗？
zh.a: 现货空白样品免费——大多数现货款式您无需支付任何费用。印您 Logo 的打样会收取小额打样费，用于覆盖制版与机时成本，该费用在同设计大货订单中全额抵扣。打样是我们赢得您首笔大货订单的方式，而非利润来源。

items.q: What is a can cooler — is it the same as a "koozie"?
items.a: Yes, it is the same product — an insulating sleeve that wraps a beverage can. "Koozie" is a registered trademark, so manufacturers and careful buyers use the generic term "can coolers" (or "can koozies" when searching). Ours come in foam and neoprene-style materials with full-color printing.

items.q: Where to buy wholesale LED light up cups?
items.a: Direct from a manufacturer like BOOM Drinkware — we mold and assemble LED light-up cups in-house, so wholesale buyers skip importer markups. Choose from multi-mode LEDs, sound-activated bases and custom-printed bodies, with MOQs from 100 pieces and artwork review on every order.

en.title: Plastic Cup Materials Guide: PP vs PET vs Tritan vs Silicone | BOOM Drinkware
en.description: PP vs PET vs Tritan vs silicone — compare cost, clarity, durability & food safety of custom cup materials. Honest factory guide with per-material pricing.
en.h1: Cup Materials Guide: PP vs PET vs Tritan™ vs Silicone
en.lead: We mold millions of cups a year in exactly four material families. Here’s the honest comparison — clarity, cost, durability and food safety — so you can spec the right cup the first time.
en.heroAlt: PP vs PET vs Tritan vs silicone cup materials lineup
en.quickAnswer: PP is the low-cost all-rounder for stadium cups; PET gives glass-like clarity for cold drinks; Tritan™ is premium, ultra-clear and dishwasher-proof; food-grade silicone is shatterproof, flexible and heat-safe. All four are BPA-free and FDA food-contact compliant at BOOM Drinkware.
en.tableH2: The four materials, side by side
en.tableNote: Tap a material column header to grab its anchor link — product pages across this site deep-link into this table.

chapters.p1: PP is the cup you’ve held at every stadium, tailgate and school carnival. It molds fast, prints beautifully with screen and UV processes, and shrugs off drops that would crack a brittle cup. The hand-feel is slightly flexible — squeeze it and it springs back.
chapters.p2: Spec PP when the job is volume: giveaways, events, anywhere the per-unit number matters more than crystal clarity. Skip it when you need glass-like transparency or a premium retail shelf presence — that’s Tritan’s job.

chapters.h2: PET: crystal clarity for cold drinks
chapters.alt: Crystal clear PET plastic cups stacked
chapters.p1: PET is the clear cup behind every iced coffee and smoothie bar counter. Nothing else in our lineup matches its glass-like transparency at this price — the drink itself becomes the display. It’s rigid, crisp and prints cleanly with UV and screen inks.
chapters.p2: Spec PET for cold-drink service where clarity sells: boba shops, juice bars, festivals. Skip it for hot fill or heavy reuse — PET softens above 60°C and prefers a single elegant life over hundreds of dishwasher cycles.

chapters.p1: Tritan™ is a copolyester that behaves like the love child of glass and engineering plastic: ultra-clear, drop-proof, and happy in the dishwasher for hundreds of cycles without clouding. It’s the material retail buyers ask for by name.
chapters.p2: Spec Tritan when the cup is the product — retail tumblers, 40oz handled bottles, corporate gifts meant to live on a desk for years. The resin runs 2.6–3.2× PP cost, so for one-night giveaways PP wins on math every time.

chapters.alt: Food-grade silicone collapsible cups in colors
chapters.p1: Silicone is the cup you can fold into a pocket. Food-grade platinum-cured silicone is soft, grippy, silently unbreakable and happy from a -40°C freezer to 230°C oven-level heat. Pools, boats, campsites and kids — anywhere glass and rigid plastic are a liability.
chapters.p2: Spec silicone for outdoor retail, travel and pool programs — especially our collapsible line. The matte surface takes debossing and screen print, not photo gradients; if you need full-color art on a hard wall, that’s UV on PP or Tritan.

en.costH2: What material does to your unit price
en.costLead: Same 16oz cup, same one-color print, quoted at 500 pieces. We publish this because factory-direct means no pricing mystery.
costRows: Similar resin cost, slightly slower molding
en.videoH2: Watch: the four materials, explained on the floor
en.safetyH2: Every material above ships with batch-level documentation.
en.safetyLead: FDA food-contact, LFGB, BPA-free and Prop 65 screening — the paperwork travels with your order.

faqs.q: Is PP or PET better for custom stadium cups?
faqs.a: For hot-fill toughness and the lowest unit cost, choose PP — it flexes instead of cracking and molds fast. Choose PET when crystal clarity on cold drinks is the selling point. Most stadium cup programs run PP.

faqs.q: Is Tritan worth the premium?
faqs.a: For retail tumblers and 40oz bottles, yes — Tritan stays glass-clear and dishwasher-proof for years, which justifies shelf pricing. For one-event giveaways, PP wins on cost every time.

faqs.q: Are silicone cups safe for hot drinks?
faqs.a: Yes — food-grade silicone handles -40°C to 230°C, is BPA-free and FDA food-contact compliant, and never leaches plasticizers. It’s the safest pick for kids, pools and travel.

faqs.q: Are all your materials BPA-free?
faqs.a: Yes — all four material families (PP, PET, Tritan™ and silicone) are BPA-free, and every order ships with batch-level documentation you can file with your compliance team.

zh.title: 塑料杯材质指南：PP vs PET vs Tritan vs 硅胶 | BOOM Drinkware
zh.description: PP、PET、Tritan、硅胶四大定制杯材质对比——成本、透明度、耐用性与食品安全一目了然。工厂直写的诚实指南，附各材质参考价格。
zh.eyebrow: 材质指南 · 工厂知识
zh.h1: 杯具材质指南：PP vs PET vs Tritan™ vs 硅胶
zh.lead: 我们每年用四种材质体系生产数百万只杯子。这份对比不讲套话——透明度、成本、耐用性与食品安全，帮您一次选对材质。
zh.heroAlt: PP、PET、Tritan 与硅胶杯材质对比
zh.quickAnswer: PP 是体育场杯的高性价比全能之选；PET 为冷饮提供玻璃般通透；Tritan™ 属于高端材质，超清透且耐洗碗机；食品级硅胶防摔、柔韧且耐高温。BOOM Drinkware 四种材质全部不含 BPA，并符合 FDA 食品接触标准。
zh.tableNote: 点击材质列表头获取锚点链接——全站产品页均深度链接至本表。

chapters.alt: 彩色 PP 聚丙烯塑料杯
chapters.p1: PP 就是您在体育场、车尾派对和校园活动上握过的那种杯子。它成型快，丝印和 UV 印刷效果出色，跌落时不会脆裂。手感略带柔韧——捏一下会回弹。
chapters.p2: 走量的场景选 PP：赠品、活动、任何单价优先于通透度的场合。如果需要玻璃般的透明度或高端零售货架感，请交给 Tritan。

chapters.h2: PET：为冷饮而生的水晶通透
chapters.alt: 堆叠的透明 PET 塑料杯
chapters.p1: PET 就是冰咖啡和冰沙吧台后的那种透明杯。在这个价位上，没有任何材质能比它更通透——饮品本身就是陈列品。刚性好、挺括，UV 与丝印效果干净利落。
chapters.p2: 冷饮场景选 PET：珍珠奶茶店、果汁吧、音乐节。热饮或长期复用请避开——PET 在 60°C 以上会变软，更适合优雅的一次性使用，而非数百次洗碗机循环。

chapters.p1: Tritan™ 是一种共聚聚酯，兼具玻璃的通透与工程塑料的坚韧：超清透、防摔，洗碗机洗数百次也不发雾。零售买家常常指名要它。
chapters.p2: 当杯子本身就是产品时选 Tritan——零售随行杯、40oz 手柄杯、要在客户桌上常驻数年的企业礼品。其原料成本是 PP 的 2.6–3.2 倍，一次性活动赠品选 PP 永远更划算。
specs: UV / 激光 / LED 产品定制

chapters.h2: 食品级硅胶：摔不坏的那一个
chapters.alt: 彩色食品级硅胶折叠杯
chapters.p1: 硅胶杯可以折进口袋。食品级铂金硫化硅胶柔软、防滑、静音防摔，从 -40°C 冷冻到 230°C 高温都安然无恙。泳池、游船、露营、儿童——任何玻璃和硬塑是隐患的地方。
chapters.p2: 户外零售、旅行和泳池项目选硅胶——尤其是我们的折叠系列。哑光表面适合压凹与丝印，不适合照片级渐变；若要在硬质杯身上做全彩图案，请选择 PP 或 Tritan 的 UV 印刷。

zh.costLead: 同一款 16oz 杯、同样单色印刷、500 只报价。我们公开这些数据，因为工厂直供意味着价格没有秘密。
costRows: 主力原料，成型周期最快
高端共聚聚酯原料，周期更慢
zh.videoH2: 视频：车间现场讲透四种材质
zh.safetyH2: 以上每种材质都随货提供批次级文件。
zh.safetyLead: FDA 食品接触、LFGB、BPA-free 与加州 65 号提案筛查——文件随订单同行。

faqs.q: 定制体育场杯选 PP 还是 PET？
faqs.a: 要耐热灌装和最低单价，选 PP——它会弯曲而不是开裂，成型也快。如果冷饮的晶莹通透是卖点，则选 PET。大多数体育场杯项目都选 PP。

faqs.q: Tritan 值得溢价吗？
faqs.a: 零售随行杯和 40oz 大容量杯值得——Tritan 多年保持玻璃般清透且耐洗碗机，撑得起零售定价。一次性活动赠品则永远是 PP 更划算。

faqs.q: 硅胶杯装热饮安全吗？
faqs.a: 安全——食品级硅胶耐温 -40°C 至 230°C，不含 BPA，符合 FDA 食品接触标准，也不会析出塑化剂。是儿童、泳池和旅行场景最安心的选择。

faqs.q: 你们所有材质都不含 BPA 吗？
faqs.a: 是的——PP、PET、Tritan™ 和硅胶四个材质体系全部不含 BPA，每个订单都随附批次级文件，可交由您的合规团队归档。

en.title: FDA & LFGB Certified Drinkware Factory | BPA-Free, Prop 65 | BOOM Drinkware
en.description: BOOM Drinkware drinkware is FDA food-contact compliant, LFGB tested, BPA-free & Prop 65 screened. Download batch report cards & see our 6-point QC.
en.lead: Every cup that leaves our factory is food-contact safe and documented. FDA, LFGB, BPA-free and Prop 65 — here’s what each certification means and the batch paperwork that backs it.
en.certCenterLine: FDA, BPA-free, Prop 65, LFGB, SGS, ISO 9001, BSCI & LED packs — numbered, verifiable, downloadable.
en.heroAlt: BOOM Drinkware QC lab bench with calipers, sample cups and test reports
en.quickAnswer: BOOM Drinkware manufactures plastic, silicone and LED drinkware compliant with FDA food-contact standards and German LFGB testing, made from BPA-free materials and screened for California Prop 65. Batch-level test reports are available on request, and every order passes a six-point QC inspection before packing.

certs.name: FDA Food-Contact (21 CFR)
certs.explainer: US Food & Drug Administration food-contact rules govern what materials may touch food and drink. Our PP, PET, Tritan and silicone resins meet FDA food-contact standards, verified by migration testing.
certs.detail: Applies to: all PP / PET / Tritan / silicone lines
certs.clause: Technical summary: overall and specific migration limits per FDA 21 CFR §§175–178 for repeated-use food-contact articles. Resin supplier declarations plus third-party migration tests are kept on file per batch.

certs.name: LFGB (German Food Code)
certs.explainer: LFGB is the German and EU food-contact benchmark — stricter than FDA on sensory testing, meaning no taste or smell transfer into drinks. US distributors request it for retail and grocery programs.
certs.detail: Applies to: all drinkware, silicone especially
certs.clause: Technical summary: LFGB §§30/31 compliance including sensory evaluation (odor & flavor neutrality) and migration testing on finished articles, not just raw resin.

certs.name: BPA-Free Materials
certs.explainer: Bisphenol-A is not used in any BOOM Drinkware material formulation — not in PP, PET, Tritan or silicone. We back the claim with resin-level declarations on every batch, not a marketing line.
certs.detail: Applies to: 100% of BOOM Drinkware products
certs.clause: Technical summary: BPA-free declaration supported by resin manufacturer certificates of analysis; Tritan is a BPA-free copolyester by chemistry, and food-grade silicone contains no bisphenols.

certs.name: California Prop 65 Screening
certs.explainer: California Proposition 65 requires warnings for listed chemicals. Our materials are screened against the Prop 65 list, and we issue a per-shipment compliance statement for your records.
certs.detail: Applies to: all shipments into California
certs.clause: Technical summary: materials screened for Prop 65 listed substances (lead, phthalates, BPA and others) with supplier declarations; screening statements issued per shipment on request.

en.reportsNote: Real batch reports are issued per order on request — the files below are redacted samples.
en.qcNote: Step 6 photos are emailed with your tracking number.
qcSteps: Material intake certs
Resin and silicone certificates verified against batch numbers before molding starts.
First-article print check
First decorated cup of every run checked for color, registration and placement.
In-line sampling (AQL 2.5)
Line inspectors pull samples at set intervals through the whole run.
Leak & seal test
Silicone and lidded lines are fill-tested and inverted — no leakers ship.
LED function test
100% of LED units are powered, cycled through every mode, and battery-checked.
Pre-pack photo report
Counted, boxed and photographed before sealing — the report lands in your inbox.

faqs.q: Are BOOM Drinkware cups FDA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes — our food-contact materials meet FDA 21 CFR requirements, verified with migration testing. A batch-level report card is available with your order on request.

faqs.q: What is LFGB and do US buyers need it?
faqs.a: LFGB is the German/EU food-contact standard with stricter sensory tests than FDA. Distributors love it for retail programs because it documents that cups won’t taint taste or smell.

faqs.q: Are your products Prop 65 compliant?
faqs.a: Our materials are screened against the California Prop 65 list and a compliance statement is available per shipment. BPA-free formulations are documented at resin level.

faqs.q: Can I get third-party (SGS) testing on my order?
faqs.a: Yes — SGS or equivalent third-party testing can be arranged per batch for volume orders. Ask for it when you request your wholesale quote and we’ll schedule it with production.

en.bandH2: Need docs for your compliance file?
en.bandLead: Request them with your quote — batch paperwork is part of the order, not an upsell.

zh.title: FDA 与 LFGB 合规杯具工厂 | BPA-Free、Prop 65 | BOOM Drinkware

certs.name: FDA 食品接触（21 CFR）
certs.explainer: 美国 FDA 食品接触法规规定了哪些材料可以接触食品饮料。我们的 PP、PET、Tritan 与硅胶原料均符合 FDA 食品接触标准，并以迁移测试验证。
certs.detail: 适用：全部 PP / PET / Tritan / 硅胶产品线
certs.clause: 技术摘要：依据 FDA 21 CFR §§175–178 对重复使用食品接触制品的总迁移与特定迁移限量。原料供应商声明与第三方迁移测试按批次存档。

certs.name: LFGB（德国食品法）
certs.explainer: LFGB 是德国与欧盟的食品接触基准，感官测试比 FDA 更严格——意味着杯中饮品不会串味。美国分销商在零售与商超项目中常会要求。
certs.detail: 适用：全部杯具，尤其硅胶系列
certs.clause: 技术摘要：LFGB §§30/31 合规，包含感官评估（气味与味道中性）以及成品（而非仅原料）迁移测试。

certs.name: BPA-Free 材质
certs.explainer: BOOM Drinkware 所有材质配方均不使用双酚 A——PP、PET、Tritan、硅胶皆然。我们用每批次的原料级声明支撑这一承诺，而非一句营销口号。
certs.clause: 技术摘要：BPA-free 声明由原料生产商分析证书支持；Tritan 在化学结构上即为不含 BPA 的共聚聚酯，食品级硅胶不含双酚类物质。

certs.name: 加州 65 号提案筛查
certs.explainer: 加州 65 号提案要求对清单化学品进行警示。我们的材质均对照 65 号提案清单筛查，并可按出货批次出具合规声明供您存档。
certs.detail: 适用：所有发往加州的货物
certs.clause: 技术摘要：对照 65 号提案清单物质（铅、邻苯二甲酸酯、BPA 等）进行材质筛查，附供应商声明；筛查声明可按批次应要求出具。

qcSteps: 原料入场证书

点数、装箱、封箱前拍照——报告直达您的邮箱。

faqs.q: BOOM Drinkware 的杯子符合 FDA 标准吗？
faqs.a: 符合——我们的食品接触材料满足 FDA 21 CFR 要求，并通过迁移测试验证。批次级报告卡可随订单应要求提供。

faqs.q: LFGB 是什么？美国买家需要吗？
faqs.a: LFGB 是德国/欧盟食品接触标准，感官测试比 FDA 更严格。分销商在零售项目中很看重它，因为它证明杯子不会影响饮品的味道和气味。

faqs.q: 你们的产品符合 65 号提案吗？
faqs.a: 我们的材质均对照加州 65 号提案清单筛查，合规声明可按批次提供。BPA-free 配方在原料层面有据可查。

faqs.q: 可以为我的订单安排第三方（SGS）检测吗？
faqs.a: 可以——大批量订单可按批次安排 SGS 或同等级第三方检测。在申请批发报价时提出即可，我们会与生产排期同步安排。

faqs.q: What discounts do distributors get?
faqs.a: Tier bands below the published wholesale list, growing with your annual volume. The exact price list is shared after your application is approved.

faqs.q: Do you offer net payment terms?
faqs.a: Yes — net-15, then net-30, for established accounts after three prepaid orders and a credit check. The credit application is part of the form above.

faqs.q: How does blind shipping work?
faqs.a: Your logo on packing slips and labels, no BOOM Drinkware branding anywhere in the box, and multi-address US drop-shipping on a single PO. See how a Texas distributor runs it in our case studies.

faqs.q: Can you kit products from different categories into one set?
faqs.a: Yes — our kitting service assembles gift sets across categories with per-component 10-piece minimums, custom boxes and a per-kit QC photo report.

faqs.q: Do you support Amazon FBA sellers?
faqs.a: Yes — retail boxing, barcode labeling and full FBA prep are available through our OEM program and the kitting service.

faqs.q: 分销商能拿到什么折扣？
faqs.a: 低于公开批发牌价的阶梯折扣，随年采购量递增。具体价格表在申请通过后提供。

faqs.q: 你们提供账期吗？
faqs.a: 提供——成熟账户在三次预付订单并通过信用审核后开放 Net-15，进而 Net-30。信用申请包含在上方的表格中。

faqs.q: 盲发代发如何运作？

faqs.a: 可以——组套服务跨品类组装礼品套装，起订量为10件，配定制礼盒与每套质检拍照报告。

faqs.q: 支持 Amazon FBA 卖家吗？

BYF_GUIDES_2476626.title: Custom Collapsible Silicone Cups | BOOM Drinkware
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.zhTitle: 定制折叠硅胶杯采购指南 | BOOM Drinkware
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.name: Custom Collapsible Silicone Cups
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.summary: Choose a BOOM Drinkware collapsible silicone cup reference and tell us your required capacity, open size and folded size. Capacity and dimensions are customized to your project; discuss the structure, logo and packing for a quotation.
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.zhSummary: 选择 BOOM Drinkware 折叠硅胶杯参考型号，并告知目标容量、展开尺寸和折叠尺寸。容量与尺寸按客户需求定制，询价时一起确认结构、Logo 和包装。
rows: Compare the cup body, rim, base and any lid or sleeve by model. A collapsible design does not by itself establish leak resistance.
逐款核对杯身、杯口、杯底及盖套。可折叠不等于已经证实防漏。

Tell us your required serving capacity, open dimensions and folded dimensions. These are project specifications to discuss and customize, rather than missing records or a fixed size promised by the reference name.
请提供目标容量、展开尺寸和折叠后尺寸。这些按需求咨询定制，不作为资料缺失，也不以参考名称中的数值锁定供货规格。
Review the usable wall area in both open and folded positions. Agree the decoration method and sample appearance for the selected surface.
同时检查展开、折叠状态的图稿位置，按该表面确认工艺并审核样品。
State the intended beverage and use. Request model-specific care instructions before making hot-drink, dishwasher, microwave or sealing claims.
说明饮品和场景，使用该型号的清洁说明；耐热、洗碗机、微波炉或密封性能需另有依据。
faqs: How do I choose a collapsible silicone cup for an outdoor project?

Start with your required serving capacity, carrying space and need for a lid. Choose a reference model and send your target open and folded dimensions; capacity and size are customized and agreed in the quotation.
户外项目如何选择折叠硅胶杯？
先确定目标容量、携带空间和杯盖需求，再选参考型号，提供展开与折叠后的目标尺寸，按项目定制并在报价中确认。
Can I customize the capacity and folded size of a collapsible cup?

Yes. Contact us with the capacity, open dimensions and folded size you need. We review the reference structure and confirm the agreed specification for your project; a volume in a reference name does not fix the customized order.
折叠杯容量和折叠尺寸可以定制吗？
可以。请直接咨询并提供目标容量、展开尺寸和折叠后尺寸，结合参考结构确认项目规格；参考名称中的容量不限定定制订单。
Can collapsible cups be decorated with my logo?
Request a review of the artwork size, position and intended folding action on the exact model. Decoration compatibility and the finished appearance should be approved with a sample.
能否定制 Logo？
请按具体型号审核图稿尺寸、位置以及折叠动作的影响，工艺和成品外观以样品确认为准。
What is the minimum order quantity for custom cups?
The minimum order quantity is 10 pieces. Include the model, artwork, colour, packing and required quantity when requesting a project quotation.
定制杯的起订量是多少？
起订量为10件。请提供所选型号、图稿、颜色、包装和所需数量，以便确认项目报价。
How much do custom cups with a logo cost?

A project quote is needed because the model, quantity, decoration, accessories, packing and delivery affect the price. Compare the same specification and ask which setup, sample, tooling and delivery charges are included. External reference prices are not published here as confirmed selling prices.
带 Logo 的定制杯价格是多少？
需要按项目报价，型号、数量、装饰、配件、包装和交付都会影响价格。 比较相同规格，并核对制版、样品、模具和运费是否包含。外采参考价不作为本站确认售价发布。
Can I request samples before a bulk order?

Yes. Discuss an existing model sample, a decorated sample or a pre-production sample for the selected project. Confirm the sample specification, charges, preparation time, freight and any credit terms in writing. A digital proof checks layout and does not replace physical sample approval.
批量下单前能否索取样品？
可以。可按项目沟通现有型号样品、带图稿样品或产前确认样。 书面确认样品规格、费用、制作时间、运费及抵扣条件。数字效果图用于检查布局，不能替代实物样品审核。
How are production and delivery dates confirmed?

Dates are confirmed for the agreed model, quantity, artwork, sample approval and delivery destination. State the required arrival date and distinguish production completion from transit time. Confirm the delivery method, trade terms and schedule in the quotation.
生产和交付日期如何确认？
根据已确认型号、数量、图稿、样品审核和收货地确认日期。 请提供希望到货的日期，并区分生产完成时间与运输时间，在报价中确认运输方式、贸易条款和进度。

BYF_GUIDES_2476626.title: Custom Logo Coasters for Bulk Orders | BOOM Drinkware
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.zhTitle: 定制 Logo 杯垫批量采购 | BOOM Drinkware
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.name: Custom Logo Coasters
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.summary: Order custom-size silicone and LED coaster references for beverage promotions, hospitality and branded gifts. We customize coaster dimensions to your requirements. Send the cup-base diameter, desired shape and logo to discuss the selected configuration.
BYF_GUIDES_2476626.zhSummary: 硅胶与 LED 杯垫均可按客户要求定制尺寸。提供杯底直径、目标形状和 Logo，按饮品推广、酒店或品牌礼品项目确认配置；杯垫不使用容量参数。
rows: Coaster dimensions are customized to your requirements. Send the cup-base diameter, desired outline and usable contact area, then agree the dimensions and any raised edge for the selected design.
杯垫可按客户要求定制大小。请提供杯底直径、目标外形和可用接触面积，再确认最终尺寸与凸边结构。
Use the recorded model material. Surface texture, flexibility and colour options should be agreed for the chosen model, without assuming that all coasters share the same properties.
采用已记录材料，逐款确认纹理、柔软度和颜色；不同杯垫的性能不自动通用。
Review the logo dimensions, fine detail and colour contrast. Confirm the suitable marking or decoration method on the selected surface.
核对 Logo 尺寸、细节与对比度，按所选表面确认适用工艺。
For a light-up model, confirm activation, power components and cleaning instructions separately. Silicone and LED variants should not share unverified electrical or care claims.
发光款另行核对触发方式、电源组件和清洁说明；不向普通硅胶杯垫套用电气或清洁性能。
faqs: What should I send for a custom coaster quote?
Include the model, container-base dimensions, logo, intended venue, estimated quantity and destination. Confirm material, size, artwork, packing and any LED configuration in the quotation.
询杯垫价格需要哪些资料？
提供型号、杯底尺寸、Logo、使用场所、数量和目的地，报价中确认材料、尺寸、图稿、包装及 LED 配置。
Are all silicone coasters absorbent or heat resistant?
Do not assume either property from the material name or image. State the intended use and request evidence or a sample for the selected model and surface.
硅胶杯垫都吸水或耐热吗？
不能仅从材料名或图片作此判断。说明用途，并针对具体型号和表面查看依据或样品。
Can I order coasters in a custom size?

Yes. Tell us your required diameter or length and width, shape, thickness and cup-base dimensions. We customize the size to your project and confirm the drawing, logo area and sample before the order. Coasters are specified by dimensions, not beverage capacity.
杯垫可以按需要定制尺寸吗？
可以。请提供目标直径或长宽、形状、厚度和杯底尺寸，按项目定制大小，并确认图纸、标识区域和样品。杯垫使用尺寸参数，不使用饮品容量。
How much do custom cups with a logo cost?

A project quote is needed because the model, quantity, decoration, accessories, packing and delivery affect the price. Compare the same specification and ask which setup, sample, tooling and delivery charges are included. External reference prices are not published here as confirmed selling prices.
带 Logo 的定制杯价格是多少？
需要按项目报价，型号、数量、装饰、配件、包装和交付都会影响价格。 比较相同规格，并核对制版、样品、模具和运费是否包含。外采参考价不作为本站确认售价发布。
Can I add my logo to a cup, coaster or opener?

Request a decoration review for the selected model, surface and logo position. The artwork and finished appearance should be approved before bulk production. Provide the design, intended size and colour references. Do not assume that a marking method suitable for one material will work on every product.
杯子、杯垫或开瓶器能否增加 Logo？
可针对所选型号、表面和 Logo 位置审核装饰方案，并在批量生产前确认图稿和成品外观。 提供设计、目标尺寸和颜色参考。某种材料适用的工艺不自动适用于其他产品。
Can I request samples before a bulk order?

Yes. Discuss an existing model sample, a decorated sample or a pre-production sample for the selected project. Confirm the sample specification, charges, preparation time, freight and any credit terms in writing. A digital proof checks layout and does not replace physical sample approval.
批量下单前能否索取样品？
可以。可按项目沟通现有型号样品、带图稿样品或产前确认样。 书面确认样品规格、费用、制作时间、运费及抵扣条件。数字效果图用于检查布局，不能替代实物样品审核。
Can I mix product models, colours or designs in one order?

Ask for a quote that lists each model, colour, design and quantity separately. Mixing options depend on the project and production arrangement. Do not assume that a combined total meets every model’s minimum or that multiple designs share the same setup charge.
一张订单能否混合型号、颜色或图稿？
请分项列出型号、颜色、图稿和各自数量报价，混款条件取决于项目与生产安排。 不要假设合计数量一定满足每款起订量，也不要假设不同图稿共用同一制版费。

提供目标试饮容量和携带尺寸，再核对样品摆放与握持。
Compare carrying dimensions, the open rim and any lid or accessory. Verify the required use and cleaning instructions.
比较携带尺寸、展开杯口和杯盖或配件，并核对用途及清洁说明。
Check the serving capacity separately from folding size; review the logo while the wall is open and folded.
区分容量与折叠尺寸，并同时审核展开、折叠状态的 Logo。
configuration: What should be agreed for the cup body, lid and artwork?
杯体、杯盖与图稿需要确认什么？
Agree your target capacity, open and folded dimensions, cup construction, lid or sleeve, artwork and packing. The customized specification is confirmed in the quotation and sample review.
确认目标容量、展开和折叠尺寸、杯体结构、杯盖或套件、图稿和包装，定制规格在报价与样品审核中确认。
checks: Serving and handling
Check the actual serving requirement and the sample in its intended open position.
饮用与握持
在实际展开状态核对目标饮用要求和样品。
Folding and components
Review the folding action, open and folded dimensions and included components.
折叠与组件
核对折叠动作、展开与折叠尺寸以及所含组件。
Artwork
Approve the design position and appearance on the selected model and surface.
图稿
审核具体型号和表面的图稿位置与外观。
Packing
Check individual packing, protection and bulk-carton requirements for the agreed quantity.
包装
按数量核对单件包装、保护及外箱要求。

heading: How do I choose between silicone and LED coaster references?
硅胶杯垫与 LED 杯垫如何选型？
summary: Choose the required function before the appearance. Ordinary silicone coasters and light-up variants need different checks, and all should be matched to the actual cup base and table surface. Coaster size is customized to the dimensions you require.
先确定功能，再选择外观。普通硅胶杯垫与发光款核对项目不同，都需要匹配实际杯底和桌面。 杯垫大小可按客户要求定制。
choices: Compare the recorded material, shape, usable surface and logo area. Do not infer absorption or heat performance.
比较已有材料、形状、可用面积和标识区域，不推断吸水或耐热性能。
Confirm the light activation, power arrangement and intended cleaning procedure for the model.
按型号确认触发方式、供电安排和清洁方法。
Check the actual cup-base contact area, raised edges, presentation and packing together.
一起核对杯底接触面积、凸边、组合外观和包装。
configuration: What should be agreed for the coaster surface and logo?
杯垫表面与 Logo 需要确认什么？
Agree the model and dimensions, surface texture, artwork size, colours and packing. Check the sample with your actual cup and venue surface before approving the combination.
确认型号、尺寸、表面纹理、图稿尺寸、颜色与包装。批准组合前，用实际杯子和使用场所的桌面检查样品。
checks: Container contact
Check the base contact and any raised edge against the chosen cup.
杯底接触
核对目标杯底与杯垫接触面和凸边。
Surface and appearance
Review the agreed surface, edges, artwork and colour reference.
表面与外观
审核约定表面、边缘、图稿与颜色参考。
Venue conditions
Review the intended container and surface conditions on a sample without assuming performance from the image.
使用条件
在目标杯子与桌面条件下检查样品，不由图片推断性能。
LED configuration
For powered variants, separately confirm activation, power components and care instructions.
LED 配置
电动发光款另核触发方式、电源组件和清洁说明。

heading: Which opener mechanism fits my bottles and promotion?
哪种开启方式适合我的瓶子与推广项目？
summary: Match the opener to the closure first: crown-cap openers, manual wine corkscrews and powered wine openers serve different needs. Then compare the body, attachments, logo area and packing.
先按封口选择皇冠瓶盖开瓶器、手动红酒螺旋开瓶器或电动红酒开瓶器，再比较主体、附件、标识区域和包装。
choices: Confirm compatibility with your intended capped bottle and compare the body shape and marking area.
核对目标瓶盖兼容性，比较主体形状与标识区域。
Confirm the cork and opening method; identify any cutter, lever or other supplied component.
核对瓶塞及开启方式，列明割锡刀、杠杆或其他实际部件。
Electric wine openers use aluminum and ABS components with PD power supply. Compare the operating method and itemised accessory list.
电动红酒开瓶器或套装
电动红酒开瓶器采用铝制与 ABS 组件、PD 供电，比较操作方式与逐项附件清单。
configuration: How should the body, accessories and gift packing be specified?
主体、附件及礼品包装应该如何列明？

Use an itemised specification for the opener, stand, cutter, stopper and power components as applicable. State each relevant material separately; a body-material record does not define the entire kit.
按需分项列明主体、底座、割锡刀、瓶塞及电源组件，并分别确认材料；主体材料记录不能定义整套材料。
checks: Opening function
Check the approved opening action with the intended cap or cork and model instructions.
开启功能
按说明使用目标瓶盖或瓶塞核对约定开启动作。
Body and moving parts
Review the finish, edges, assembly and applicable moving components on a sample.
主体与活动部件
用样品审核表面、边缘、装配及活动部件。
Powered configuration
Specify PD power supply for electric openers and agree the included power components, connector and any battery information for the selected kit.
供电配置
电动开瓶器注明 PD 供电，按套装确认电源组件、接口及适用的电池信息。
Branding and presentation
Approve the marking area, artwork, accessory layout and gift or bulk packing.
品牌与包装
批准标识区域、图稿、附件布局及礼品或散装包装。

en.name: Custom LED Drinkware & Bar Accessories | BOOM Drinkware
en.description: Explore custom LED drinkware, light-up cups, LED ice buckets and branded bar accessories. Review product models, logo options, LED configuration and the production workflow for your project.

itemListElement.name: Home
LED Customization

mainEntity.name: What can I customize on LED drinkware?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the product model, logo, body colour and packaging. Lighting colours, modes, activation and power options depend on the selected module and housing. New tooling or electronics changes are reviewed separately.

mainEntity.name: Do all LED cups have the same light effects or batteries?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Review the actual model and sample. Button, pressure or liquid activation, colour-changing effects, battery access and charging arrangements are model-specific.

mainEntity.name: Can I add a logo to light-up cups, ice buckets and coasters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share the model and vector artwork. Confirm substrate compatibility, print area and readability with the light switched on and off before approving the decoration sample.

mainEntity.name: What are the MOQ and production lead time?

acceptedAnswer.text: They depend on the model, artwork, lighting configuration, packaging and development scope. Send estimated quantities and the required arrival date for a project quotation. Stock purchase minimums are not custom-logo minimums.

mainEntity.name: Are LED drinkware products waterproof or dishwasher safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not assume either property. Follow the care instructions for the selected model, keep electrical components away from moisture as instructed, and request relevant test information for any special requirement.

mainEntity.name: Is glow-in-the-dark or UV-reactive drinkware the same as LED drinkware?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. LED products use an electrical light source. UV-reactive and glow-in-the-dark materials work differently; they are not included in this LED model selection unless the product also has an LED module.

mainEntity.name: What should I send for an LED product quotation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send model numbers or reference images, estimated quantities, intended use, logo artwork, desired lighting, power preference, packaging and destination. Identify any required tests or documents so the quotation can define their scope.

zh.name: LED 发光杯与酒具定制 | BOOM Drinkware
zh.description: 浏览 LED 发光杯、LED 冰桶与发光酒具配件，按型号核对 Logo、灯效和供电配置，并了解从需求、成型、组装到检查与包装的定制生产流程。

itemListElement.name: 首页
LED 产品定制

mainEntity.name: LED 发光产品可以定制哪些内容？

acceptedAnswer.text: 从产品型号、Logo、外观颜色与包装开始确认。灯色、模式、触发与供电选项取决于所选灯组和壳体；新模具及电路改动单独评估。

mainEntity.name: 所有 LED 杯的灯效和电池都一样吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不一样。按具体型号和样品核对按键、压力或液体触发、变色灯效、电池更换及充电方式，不能从其他款式推断。

mainEntity.name: LED 杯、冰桶和杯垫可以加 Logo 吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 请提供型号与矢量图稿，先确认材质适配、印区及亮灯／熄灯时的可读性，再确认实物装饰样品。

mainEntity.name: 起订量与生产交期是多少？

acceptedAnswer.text: 按型号、图稿、灯组配置、包装和开发范围报价。请提供预估数量与到货要求，现货起购量不能作为加印 Logo 的定制起订量。

mainEntity.name: LED 发光酒具可以浸水或机洗吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不要默认可以。按具体型号的使用与清洁说明操作，依说明保护电子部件。如有特殊要求，应核对对应测试资料。

mainEntity.name: 夜光、UV 反应产品和 LED 产品是同一种吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不是。LED 使用电驱动光源，UV 反应与夜光材料的发光机制不同；本页不把没有 LED 灯组的产品列入 LED 型号。

mainEntity.name: 询价需要提供什么资料？

acceptedAnswer.text: 提供型号或参考图、数量、场景、Logo、目标灯效、供电偏好、包装与目的地。所需测试和文件也请列明，以便在报价中明确范围。

static_value_1723027.text: Ask five suppliers what custom cups cost and you will get five different answers — because "custom cups" spans a $0.40 stadium cup and a $4.50 full-wrap 40 oz tumbler. As a factory that quotes these numbers daily, here is the honest 2026 breakdown: what drives the price, what each quantity tier really costs, and where buyers routinely overpay.
What does a custom cup cost at each quantity tier?

Quantity is the single biggest price lever, because setup, plate-making and print calibration are fixed costs spread across your run. These are typical all-in factory-direct figures for a 16 oz plastic cup with a one-color print, cup included:

static_value_1723027.text: If your project is volume-driven, our [[wholesale drinkware|/wholesale/]] program prices every break point transparently, so you can see exactly what the next tier saves before you commit.
Which factors move the price per cup?

Five levers account for almost every dollar of difference between quotes: cup style and material (Tritan™ costs more than PP), print process and color count (one-color screen is cheapest; full-color UV adds $0.20–$0.60 per unit), print coverage (a full wrap costs more than a one-side logo), quantity tier, and freight method. Air freight can double landed cost on light, bulky cartons — plan ocean lead times when you can.
The cheapest quote is rarely the cheapest order. Ask what is included: proof, plates, duties and freight turn a low unit price into a high invoice fast.
How do you get factory pricing on a small order?

Start at the true factory floor instead of a reseller: our with a minimum order of 10 pieces, which already prices far below print-on-demand. Keep the design to one ink color, pick a stock cup color, and reuse the same artwork on reorders to skip setup fees. Our [[low MOQ custom cups|/low-moq-custom-cups/]] program was built exactly for this — small runs at real factory economics, with an artwork review before anything prints.
What should you budget for hidden costs?

Budget for three line items beyond the unit price: the one-time setup fee ($25–$45, waived on reorders), shipping and duties (we quote door-to-door so this is never a surprise), and rush fees if your timeline is under 10 business days. A supplier who will not itemize these is telling you something. Every BOOM Drinkware quote lists all five cost components separately — unit price, setup, proofing, freight and timeline — so the number you approve is the number you pay.

body.text: These are the two processes we run most on the factory floor, and the right choice is almost never about print quality — both look sharp. It is about your artwork, your quantity and your budget. Here is the comparison we walk every buyer through before quoting.
How do the two processes actually differ?

[[Screen printing|/screen-printing/]] pushes ink through a mesh stencil onto the cup, one color at a time — each color needs its own screen and its own pass. [[UV printing on cups|/uv-printing/]] jets CMYK ink digitally and cures it instantly with ultraviolet light, like an inkjet printer wrapped around a cup. No screens, no film, no color-count limits.

body.caption: Screen printing vs UV printing on custom cups
head: Factor
Screen Printing
UV Printing

body.text: Which process is cheaper for my order?

Under about 200 pieces, UV printing is almost always cheaper because screen setup fees dominate a small run. Past 500 pieces with a one- or two-color logo, screen printing pulls ahead on unit cost and never gives the lead back. Between 200 and 500 it depends on your color count — send the artwork and we will quote both processes side by side.
Rule of thumb from the print floor: one or two colors and a big crowd — screen it. Full color or a small crowd — UV it.
Can I combine both on one cup?

Yes, and it is more common than you would think: a screen printed base logo for durability plus a UV-printed variable element (event dates, names, QR codes) that changes per batch. Tell your rep what you are trying to achieve — mixing processes is a factory trick that saves real money on recurring event programs.

faqs.q: Is UV printing dishwasher safe?
faqs.a: UV prints are durable but we recommend hand washing for maximum print life; screen prints handle top-rack dishwasher cycles comfortably.

faqs.q: Which process handles metallic ink?
faqs.a: Screen printing — metallic and neon spot inks are a screen specialty. UV printing simulates metallics in CMYK but cannot lay down true metallic ink.

body.text: An LED cup looks like magic on a dark bar top, but the engineering is simple: a sealed light module in the base, a translucent plastic body that carries the glow upward, and a switch that decides when the party starts. Here is everything a buyer should know before speccing a nightlife order.
How do LED light-up cups actually work?

The base contains coin-cell batteries, one or more LEDs and a small circuit board, all ultrasonically sealed against liquid. Light fires upward into the cup walls, which act like a light pipe — frosted and colored bodies diffuse the glow, clear bodies sparkle. Activation comes in three flavors: push-button (cheapest, most reliable), liquid-activated (lights when poured), and sound-activated (pulses with music).
How long do the batteries last?

Expect 8–12 hours on flash mode and up to 24 hours on steady glow from standard coin cells. Venue programs should spec replaceable-battery bases — the cup outlives many battery sets. For multi-night events, our [[LED light up cups|/led-light-up-cups/]] line ships with batteries installed and tested, plus spares on request.
A glowing cup is a walking billboard. Put the logo where the light is — a print over the base glows brighter than any sign in the room.
What should nightclubs and festivals spec?

Prioritize three things: sealed, food-safe bases (non-negotiable — the electronics must never touch the drink), sound activation for dance floors, and bold one-color prints that read in the dark. Custom-printed LED cups are the signature serve of every serious [[nightclub LED drinkware|/nightclub-led-drinkware/]] program — bottle service trays, glow shots and branded highballs that guests photograph all night.
Are LED cups safe and reusable?

Yes on both counts, when built correctly. BOOM Drinkware LED modules are ultrasonically sealed and the cups are molded from BPA-free, food-contact plastic — hand wash only, never submerged base-first. With replaceable batteries, a single cup runs for years of weekend service, which is why per-use cost often beats disposable cups for busy venues.

faqs.q: Can LED cups go in the dishwasher?
faqs.a: No — the electronics in the base are water-resistant but not dishwasher-proof. Hand wash and keep the base out of standing water.

static_value_1740923.text: Most verification guides are written by sourcing agents selling their own services. This one is written from the factory side: here is exactly how buyers should vet us — and every other cup supplier quoting you this week. Follow the five steps below and you will filter out 95% of the risk before your deposit leaves your account.

static_value_1741354.text: A cup is a food-contact product. If the resin is wrong or the ink migrates, it is not a cosmetic defect — it is a safety issue with your logo on it. Drinkware is also the promotional industry's most-cited category for California Prop 65 violations, which means distributors and retail buyers are legally exposed when a supplier cuts corners. One bad batch does not stay the factory's problem; it becomes your brand's problem.

static_value_1742278.text: Honest aside from a factory: a trading company is sometimes fine — for small, mixed-category orders where one PO covers cups, lanyards and tote bags, a good trader saves you real logistics pain. Where traders cost you is mold changes, custom colors and QC accountability, because every request passes through a middle layer. If your program is ongoing and cup-focused, work with a [[custom drinkware manufacturer|/oem-manufacturer/]] directly.

static_value_1742815.text: Demand documents in the same order you will need them in procurement. At the RFQ filter: an FDA food-contact migration report (21 CFR 175/177) and a BPA-free test report — if a supplier cannot produce these two, the conversation is over. At background-check stage: an SGS (or Intertek/TÜV) third-party report with a verifiable number, ISO 9001 for process discipline, and a BSCI social audit if you sell into retail programs.

static_value_1743259.text: One nuance separates pros from poseurs: the FDA does not "approve" or "certify" cups. What compliant means is third-party migration testing against 21 CFR limits. Any supplier claiming to be "FDA certified" is telling you they do not understand their own paperwork. Our full set — with report numbers and one-line verification guides — lives in the [[drinkware certificates|/certificates/]] download center.

static_value_1744199.text: We publish report numbers precisely because they verify — you can cross-check our [[compliance reports|/compliance/]] the same way before you ever ask us for a quote.

static_value_1745090.text: On a live video call, do not let them park the camera in a showroom. Ask to walk the raw-material area, the molding or silicone lines, the aging racks (for LED items) and the QC bench — in one continuous take if you can. Real factories enjoy this request; traders stall. You are welcome to [[tour our custom cup factory|/factory/]] exactly this way.

static_value_1746800.text: Any supplier who hesitates when you say 'my inspector visits Thursday' just failed the audit.

static_value_1746981.text: The strongest signal is proactivity: proof offered before you ask and before you pay. A trustworthy cup supplier volunteers batch QC photos with your order, container-loading photos with visible container and seal numbers, redacted audit summaries on request, and an open invitation for your own inspector. If a supplier's idea of transparency is a logo wall on a PDF, keep looking — the checklist below turns everything in this guide into a one-page scorecard.

static_value_1747487.q: How do I know if a cup supplier is a real factory?
static_value_1747487.a: Check the business license scope (production, not just trade), match the legal entity name on the license to your contract, and ask for a live video walk-through of the molding and printing lines. Real factories show machines; traders show showrooms. See how we open our own floor on the /factory/ page.

static_value_1747487.q: Is FDA approval required for custom cups?
static_value_1747487.a: The FDA doesn't approve or certify cups. Compliant means the materials meet FDA food-contact standards, proven by third-party migration testing to 21 CFR limits. Ask for the report number and verify it — ours are published in the /certificates/ center.

static_value_1747487.q: Should I pay for a third-party inspection?
static_value_1747487.a: For first orders over roughly $5,000, yes — an SGS or QIMA audit costs a few hundred dollars and is the cheapest insurance in sourcing. A supplier who welcomes inspections is effectively pre-vetted; see what ours covers on the /compliance/ page.

static_value_1894554.note: Eighteen injection machines from 90T to 530T run food-grade PP, PET and Tritan pellets around the clock, with robot-arm demolding on the high-cavitation cup molds. Daily capacity sits around 400,000 cups across the hall. As an injection molding drinkware manufacturer, we control wall thickness, weight and clarity at the machine — not at a re-seller’s desk.

Platinum-cured, food-grade silicone is compression-molded on vulcanizing presses, then post-cured to drive off volatiles. This line is LFGB-tested and produces our collapsible and kids’ ranges. Demolding is done by hand so edges and seams get a visual check on every piece.

LED modules are sealed into battery compartments, then 100% of units go onto 24-hour aging racks, fully powered and cycling through every light mode. DOA units are logged per batch and pulled before packing. The electrical compliance file (FCC Part 15 SDoC, CE, RoHS, UN38.3) ships with LED orders.

Review screen printing, UV printing, laser engraving, heat transfer and LED product customization for your project. Approve the artwork, physical sample and applicable production checks for the selected model.

The QC lab sits between production and packing, so nothing reaches a carton unchecked. Calipers, torque meters, a dishwasher-cycle tester and a color lightbox run the named tests below on every batch.

A 4,000㎡ finished-goods warehouse stages export cartons by order. US-bound containers load weekly, and we photograph every container number and seal before the doors close — the photo set lands in your inbox with the tracking details.
